en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style image showing a rural street scene with simple wooden houses and bare trees, surrounded by fences. One larger house dominates the right foreground, with a smaller two‑storey house and outbuilding further back. In the top left corner is printed text reading "Parti fra Løiten." The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century Scandinavian village view.
